Counting accommodation, skiing and meals, Métabief Mont d'Or suits those who want a good week without the final bill knocking them off their chair. e0840d1d2e91c18648cf520bbb868484f3079f63: Alpe d'Huez offers 140 km of well-marked runs — a mid-sized ski area ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. Alpe d'Huez's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. On snow reliability, Alpe d'Huez is in a strong position thanks to its summit at 3330 m — even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well into April. The village at 1860 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December. A stay in Alpe d'Huez is clearly expensive: 68€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and high-altitude restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps.
